main_text.p: le foret. 3. Quia licet Luc. cap. 10. v. 30. & seq. divina lex, quandam inter omnes homines constituerit cognationem ut omnes nobis sint proximi; nullam tamen sociationem aut parilitatem constituit inter animas bonorum & animas hominum, qui omnium creaturarum sunt nobilissimi. Unde facer vates: Pf. 49. v. 7. & 8.Fratrem redimendo non redimet quisquam, nec dabit Deo Precium redemptionis ejus. Nam preciosa est redemptio animæ ipsorum, & definet in seculum. Quod etiam satis innuit Salvator, dum comparat vitam nostram, ac vitam animæ nostræ, cum divitiis totius mundi, ut ostendat ea inter se comparari non posse. page.notes: The running head reads "D: Duellis." in the scan; the first word is printed with a mark I read as "De" and have marked as doubtful in the running head: De Duellis. The first word of the page is a fragment ("le foret.") continuing from the previous page. The page ends with "pre-" as a catchword, the start of "pretium" on the next page. A faint digitiser watermark at the bottom right is excluded. Printed spellings kept as they stand: "facer", "Precium", "seculum", "definet", "sociationem".
